# Security policy

Report a vulnerability privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Sour-Dev-Home/metaphor-accessibility/security/advisories/new),
never in a public issue. Only the maintainers see the report.

The mod's code is loaded into players' games, so anything that lets it run code it shouldn't, load a planted file, make
a network call or touch files outside its own folder counts as a vulnerability. So does game content or personal
information that reached the repository.

## What to include

- what you found and where (file and line, or the release);
- how to reproduce it;
- the game build and mod version, if it happens in the game.

## What happens next

This is a volunteer project with no fixed response time. A maintainer replies on the report, fixes the problem in a
private fork when it's confirmed, and publishes the advisory with the fix. You're credited unless you'd rather not be.

Only the latest release gets fixes.
